Share of total US TV viewing time
Share of total US TV viewing time

restrictions: These are U.S. TV-set viewing-time shares in a Nielsen methodology, not proportions of all YouTube viewers, mobile traffic or persons who watched videos.
YouTube share and all-streaming share use the same all-television denominator; they are nested, not additive categories.
May and July are not consecutive; July and August refer to month periods with Nielsen's methodological definitions for those releases.
July-to-August +1.6 is percentage points of TV share, not a 1.6 percent relative increase or individual viewing-minute growth rate.
The July and August published record values are not forecasts; seasonality, school calendars and sports programming change total TV usage.
Mobile app usage, cross-device unique viewers, total YouTube revenue, creator earnings and watch minutes per person cannot be recovered from these TV shares.
Nielsen's The Gauge and Media Distributor Gauge report TV-device US populations; one must not combine them with GWI self-reported global past-month YouTube use as a single sample.
